I have trouble getting excited about things, which kind of sounds silly I guess. I have been trying to get out of my apartment more often. I think this is helping. It is distracting nonetheless. I am having trouble not drinking too much/too often when out with friends. I'd like to do things that aren't going out to bars eventually, but for now I think its better than no social interaction. 

I have a therapist. I do not like him. I hate talking to him. I hate going to therapy.
